text: Catalase is a common enzyme found in both plants and animals.
You are going to investigate the activity of catalase in seeds and seedlings.
You will be provided with extracts from soaked seeds and from seedlings which have been
grown for four days. All seeds and seedlings will be from the same plant.
Catalase breaks down hydrogen peroxide into water and oxygen.

You are provided with two bean seeds, which have been soaked in water for 48 hours.
• Select one of the seeds and remove the testa (seed coat).
• The bean seed is in two parts. Carefully separate the parts and place on the white
tile.
• Use the hand lens to look at the inside of both parts, to view the embryo.
• If an embryo is not present use another bean seed.
